name: 2Captcha
description: CAPTCHA-solving platform with global availability and automatic payouts. Advertised rates start around $0.50 per 1,000 CAPTCHAs depending on type. Minimum withdrawal as low as $0.25–$1 depending on method. Crypto, Airtm, Payeer and WebMoney payouts.

name: Kolotibablo
description: CAPTCHA-solving platform operating since 2007. Web interface, 24/7 availability, withdrawals once ~$0.50 is accumulated. Crypto and local payment methods.

name: ProTypers
description: Global image-typing and data-entry platform converting scanned images to text, plus image-recognition/AI projects. Advertised rates $0.45–$1.50 per 1,000 words/images depending on work. Payment in TyperCredits.

name: MegaTypers
description: CAPTCHA and image-typing platform. Data-entry style work with flexible hours.

name: CaptchaTypers
description: CAPTCHA-typing platform. Flexible hours, low per-task payouts.

name: Captcha2Cash
description: CAPTCHA and data-entry style micro-task platform. International availability.

name: Clickworker
description: Large micro-task platform with 10M+ registered workers across 136 countries. Tasks include AI training, surveys, research, mystery visits, app testing, photos, audio and video. Weekly payments via PayPal, Payoneer, eWallet, Airtm, ACH and SEPA.

name: Microworkers
description: International micro-task platform. Tasks include data mining, categorisation, tagging, sentiment analysis, transcription, content evaluation, surveys and app testing. KYC required to activate withdrawals. Rules prohibit VPN/proxy use and fake reviews.

name: Toloka
description: AI-focused micro-task platform. Tasks include image classification, text evaluation, search evaluation, data labelling and content evaluation for AI systems. Task availability varies by country and profile.

name: Hive Micro
description: Image and data micro-task platform. Users complete image classification, bounding-box and data categorisation tasks.

name: Remotasks
description: AI data annotation platform. Tasks include image annotation, data labelling, AI training, audio/transcription and content tasks. Availability varies by country and project. Skill level ranges from beginner to advanced depending on project.

name: OneForma
description: AI, data and language task platform. Project types include translation, transcription, annotation, search evaluation, speech data and language projects. Project-based rather than continuous micro-tasks.

name: Appen
description: Major AI and data platform. Project types include AI training, data annotation, search evaluation, speech data, language data, image data and content evaluation. Project-based work, not continuous micro-tasks — expect qualification steps and waits between projects.

name: TELUS Digital AI
description: AI and search evaluation platform (formerly TELUS International / Lionbridge AI). Project types include search evaluation, ads evaluation, data annotation, AI training, language evaluation and content evaluation. Project-based, not continuous task stream.

name: Outlier
description: AI training and evaluation platform from Scale AI. Users write responses, evaluate AI output and complete reasoning tasks. Requires strong writing skills and often country-specific eligibility. Higher pay than typical micro-tasks but qualification-dependent.

name: DataAnnotation
description: AI response evaluation and writing platform. Users rate, correct and rewrite AI-generated responses across coding, writing and general knowledge. Country-restricted (US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand primarily). Application approval required.

name: Neevo
description: Audio, language and data task platform. Projects include speech recording, pronunciation, transcription, translation and text evaluation. Payment via PayPal.

name: UHRS
description: Search and data evaluation platform accessible only through participating vendors (Clickworker, Appen, TELUS Digital and others). Task types include search relevance, data evaluation, content moderation and AI training. Availability and access depend entirely on your vendor account.

name: Spare5
description: Historical image and data micro-task platform. Current operational status unclear — task availability has not been verified. Do not sign up until a live task stream is confirmed.

name: Amazon Mechanical Turk
description: CLOSING 30 SEPTEMBER 2026. Amazon has announced that Mechanical Turk will permanently shut down. Historically offered image/video processing, transcription, data research and content moderation tasks. Do not sign up.
